description: CrowNet provides a coupling framework for pedestrian or vehicle mobility and communication-network simulation, integrating Vadere, SUMO and OMNeT++ components. The provider is roVer / Munich University of Applied Sciences. Geographical and temporal coverage: The framework supports user-defined mobility scenarios, not a fixed geographic dataset. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is LGPL-2.1 for CrowNet; component licences differ. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The repository warns users to check component licences and purchase licences where required. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. The existing model-vadere record only lists CrowNet as a related tool; it does not cover this coupling framework. CrowNet explicitly couples model-vadere and model-sumo.
